purpose: Verify a zero-new-paid-service, timestamp-defensible source path for the delta-neutral funding-carry seed without downloading or inspecting strategy outcomes.

verified_public_sources.observed_claim: OKX publishes downloadable OHLC candlestick history from July 2023 onward and historical perpetual funding rates from March 2022 onward.
verified_public_sources.candidate_use: Potential bulk source for synchronized historical spot/perpetual prices and realized perpetual funding observations.

verified_public_sources.observed_claim: Public market API documents GET /api/v5/market/history-candles with instrument ID, pagination and bar size; returned candles include a completion/confirm flag.
verified_public_sources.candidate_use: Independent API cross-check and/or deterministic collection of completed spot/perpetual candles.

verified_public_sources.observed_claim: Funding-rate history remains an API-supported data family; OKX documents that funding collection frequency can vary for some perpetuals rather than remaining fixed at eight hours.
verified_public_sources.candidate_use: Requires using actual realized funding timestamps and values; fixed-interval reconstruction is forbidden.

source_window_intersection.interpretation: The documented public archives appear capable of supporting a multi-year development sample from July 2023 onward if all six fixed instruments and required funding rows are present. Coverage is not assumed until manifests are downloaded, normalized and hashed.

mandatory_dataset_freeze_before_screen: Download or collect the exact spot and perpetual completed-candle files/rows for the fixed instruments without filtering on future strategy performance.
Download or collect realized perpetual funding rows with their actual funding timestamps; never infer a constant 8h schedule.
Persist source URL/path, retrieval timestamp, upstream file/object identity where available, byte SHA256 and normalized-row SHA256 for every input.
Align spot/perpetual prices by exact completed hourly timestamps and record all missingness; no nearest-neighbor, forward-fill or future interpolation.
Verify funding observations were public/realized by each decision timestamp and bind the funding source rows used by each signal.
Freeze coverage start/end and a selection train/validation boundary before any PnL calculation.
Freeze a dataset manifest digest and candidate contract identity under the integrated label-invariant #507 implementation before screening.
predeclared_fail_closed_conditions: Any fixed spot/perpetual instrument lacks sufficient overlapping history.
Funding timestamps or values cannot be tied to actual realized/public observations.
Source files/rows cannot be hashed or deterministically reconstructed.
Missingness would require imputation across a funding event or decision timestamp.
Historical price/funding coverage is selected after seeing candidate PnL.
The repaired #507 semantic gate classifies the design as a rejected-design collision.
scientific_distinctness_note: This source path does not revive DATA-FUNDING-001. DATA-FUNDING-001 used realized funding as a directional 24h/7d return predictor. DISC-DELTA-CARRY-001-v1 targets delta-neutral cash transfer from positive funding via long spot/short perpetual with explicit two-leg costs and basis risk. Canonical semantic admission is still authoritative.
next_action: After #507 is repaired/integrated, run semantic admission first. If admitted, acquire only the frozen fixed-instrument public source set, produce a complete source/missingness/hash manifest, freeze chronology, then authorize a cheap screen.
